bugs.name: Removing a model's availability schedule leaves its publication date active
bugs.summary: Unchecking Set availability date and saving does not clear a model's saved future publication date.
bugs.expected: Disabling scheduled availability clears the future publication date and leaves the model hidden without a schedule.
bugs.actual: The checkbox stays unchecked after reopening, but the availability label still says Hidden will be visible from the old future date. Reproduced on two models scheduled for January 2027 and January 2028.
reproSteps: Sign in and open a hidden model in Modeling > Models.
Enable Set availability date, enter a future publication date, and Save.
Uncheck Set availability date and Save.
bugs.reason: User-approved rejection after pinned-source review. Unchecking scheduled availability sends publishedAt=null and isPublished=false; the page-update mutation preserves the explicit null and clears the schedule. The normal successful uncheck-save-reopen path prevents the claimed durable old publication date.
